title: Contrix Cross-Signing Publish
description: Payload content for cx.cross_signing.publish (schema_id cx.schema.cross_signing_publish.v1). Publishes the (PSK -> {SSK, USK}) binding to the principal control stream. Each subordinate key MUST carry a binding signature produced by PSK over a canonical signing input that includes trust_domain — see device-lifecycle.md §5.1.

trust_domain.description: Deployment-scope trust domain identifier. MUST match the receiver's current trust_domain and enters the PSK binding transcript so a publish from deployment A cannot be replayed into deployment B.

generation.description: Monotonically increasing publish generation. Each cx.cross_signing.reset MUST increment by 1. Receivers MUST reject publishes whose generation is <= the currently accepted generation.

expected_previous_generation.description: CAS precondition for the current accepted cross-signing generation. Initial publish uses 0. Reducers MUST accept only when this equals the current accepted generation and generation == expected_previous_generation + 1.

kid.description: Verification method identifier within the principal's DID document or key log.

alg.description: JOSE-style algorithm identifier; MUST be present in the protocol algorithm registry.

verification_method.description: PSK kid that signed this subordinate key's canonical signing input.

signature.description: base64url-encoded signature over the canonical 'cx-cross-signing-bind-v1\n' + canonical_json input, including trust_domain. See device-lifecycle.md §5.1.
